dedupe_keys.name: spatial data from aral sea region on canals roads drainage crop fields and wells

description: MELDATA publishes spatial data for the Aral Sea region of Uzbekistan. The provider describes six shapefiles covering canals, crop fields, drainage, road lines and wells. Its file directory names canal, drainage, road and well archives, crop-field archives and CSV data dictionaries. These layers describe physical infrastructure and its surrounding fields, and can supply spatial inputs for irrigation-network representation. Connectivity, hydraulic attributes and coordinate reference systems have not been established from the metadata. The resource is distinct from field-level measurements of conjunctive water use: this deposit describes mapped features. Temporal observation coverage is not stated in the inspected description. Access: the native repository lists public files and free access under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: no dataset files were downloaded; actual contents, completeness and numerical quality were not checked. Related resources are linked through the MELDATA parent collection.
